conclusion: A 628-cell factorial over bearer x definition x baseline x threshold x null x scale, 20000 permutations per cell, Benjamini-Hochberg over the WHOLE grid at once. 298 cells are nominally p<0.05 (47%) and 282 survive the correction (45%); of those, 126 survive on the PURGED scale, i.e. after removing the accuracy-gap line r115 proved any two-arm difference inherits. Bearers carrying purged survivors: prompt, person, label, stratum, contest.
